title: Numbers Held for Return Notices in the Closing Contact (Occupancy and Residency Certification)
content:
The closing contact of a health-care absence on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile carries the **return-notice numbers**: one number for each accepted return-home notice about the primary borrower received less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, the notice being a contact of its own, up to two.

| Such return notices on file | Return-notice numbers |
|---|---|
| two or more | 2 |
| exactly one | 1 |
| none | 0 |

Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.
